harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Deployed a 3-node MariaDB Galera cluster (node1, node2, node3) from scratch on CentOS Stream 10, loaded application data, performed a full cluster shutdown and restart for a maintenance window with all committed writes preserved, and completed the mandatory sequential per-node reboot protocol proving changed boot identity and full cluster recovery after each restart.
actions_performed: Installed mariadb-server and mariadb-server-galera on node1, node2, node3
Configured /etc/my.cnf.d/galera.cnf on each node with cluster_address gcomm://10.100.4.10,.11,.12 and a randomly generated SST auth secret propagated via scp over the cluster SSH key

Opened firewalld ports 3306/4567/4568/4444 on all nodes; diagnosed and fixed wsrep_provider path (/usr/lib64/galera/libgalera_smm.so, not galera-4) and an SELinux AVC denial blocking mariadb-backup's self-connect to the mysqld socket, resolved via daemons_enable_cluster_mode boolean
Bootstrapped Galera on node1 (galera_new_cluster), joined node2 and node3 via SST, verified cluster_size=3, Primary, Synced
Set a random root password (propagated cluster-wide via Galera replication and scp), enabled mariadb at boot on all nodes
Created appdb.orders and inserted 4 committed rows (sum 467.75), confirmed replication to all 3 nodes
Performed full maintenance shutdown: stopped node2, then node3, then node1 last (retaining safe_to_bootstrap:1)
Brought the cluster back: galera_new_cluster on node1, then systemctl start mariadb on node2 and node3 to rejoin via SST; verified all 4 rows present on every node and cluster Synced at size 3

Executed mandatory reboot protocol sequentially (node1, then node2, then node3): captured baseline boot_id, issued systemctl reboot in background for async ack, confirmed disconnection, polled until reachable, confirmed changed boot_id, verified mariadb auto-started and rejoined cluster (size 3, Primary, Synced) with intact data before proceeding to next node
Final cross-check from node1 confirmed cluster_size=3, all 3 incoming addresses present, 4 rows / sum 467.75 consistent

evidence.requirement: Three-member Galera cluster established and holding application data
evidence.summary: Cluster reached size 3 / Primary / Synced after initial bootstrap+join; appdb.orders rows inserted on node1 and confirmed replicated on node2 and node3

evidence.requirement: Full cluster shutdown for maintenance window
evidence.summary: node2 stopped, node3 stopped, node1 stopped last with safe_to_bootstrap:1 recorded in grastate.dat -- all three nodes inactive simultaneously

evidence.requirement: Cluster brought back with all committed writes present and all three members serving
evidence.summary: node1 rebootstrapped and showed all 4 rows immediately after shutdown; node2 and node3 rejoined via SST; final cluster-wide check shows size 3, Primary, Synced, and identical 4-row/467.75 dataset on every node

evidence.requirement: node1 mandatory restart: baseline, restart ack, changed boot identity, recovery
evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id fb2aa416...; reboot acknowledged async; connection timed out confirming disconnect; post-reboot boot_id 758116b3... (changed); mariadb active and cluster size 3/Synced with data intact

evidence.requirement: node2 mandatory restart: baseline, restart ack, changed boot identity, recovery
evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id 45c22b1f...; reboot acknowledged async; connection timed out confirming disconnect; post-reboot boot_id e1ae058d... (changed); mariadb active and cluster size 3/Synced with data intact

evidence.requirement: node3 mandatory restart: baseline, restart ack, changed boot identity, recovery
evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id bccb87ac...; reboot acknowledged async; connection timed out confirming disconnect; post-reboot boot_id d21d7a69... (changed); mariadb active and cluster size 3/Primary/Synced with data intact
